expectations.text: Running the skill's scripts/check_app.R on the produced app directory reports 0 errors.
expectations.evidence: Re-ran check_app.R on without_skill/outputs/upload_app: 'RESULT: 0 error(s), 0 warning(s)'.

expectations.text: Column dropdown choices are filled from the uploaded file's columns (updateSelectInput/updateSelectizeInput or renderUI), with the numeric dropdown limited to numeric columns.
expectations.evidence: app.R:75 nums <- names(df)[vapply(df, is.numeric, logical(1))]; app.R:77 updateSelectInput(session, "value", choices = nums); app.R:79 group choices = names(df); inside observeEvent(data(), ...) (app.R:73). Verified by inspection (testServer does not apply update* messages).

expectations.text: Code reads input$<file>$datapath and guards with req() so nothing errors before a file is uploaded.
expectations.evidence: app.R:66 req(input$file); app.R:67 read.csv(input$file$datapath, na.strings = c("", "NA")); app.R:85 req(input$value %in% names(df), input$group %in% names(df)).

expectations.text: Summary statistics use na.rm = TRUE (or equivalent) and report a per-group count of missing values; on chick_weights.csv the weight column shows 6 missing in total.
expectations.evidence: app.R:12-15 n = length(v), n_missing = sum(is.na(v)), mean(v, na.rm = TRUE), sd(v, na.rm = TRUE). testServer report table for weight by Diet: '1 220 2 102.36 56.63 | 2 120 2 123.31 71.89 | 3 120 0 142.95 86.54 | 4 118 2 135.35 68.82' -> n_missing total 6. Note: n counts rows including NAs (220, not 218 non-missing), explained in a report footnote but not in the app UI. All-missing group test: 'B 2 2 NA NA', no error.

expectations.text: When the report download is triggered with chick_weights.csv uploaded (e.g. via testServer), an HTML file is produced that contains the summary table and an embedded plot.
expectations.evidence: output$report returned .../report_weight_by_Diet.html (97,217 chars) with a kable (values above) and from knitr::image_uri() (app.R:43-46). No pandoc needed.

expectations.text: The report is rendered from a template copied to tempdir() (or otherwise not written into the app folder) and receives data via params or an explicit environment, not via global variables.
expectations.evidence: No template: build_report() (app.R:32-50) builds HTML strings directly. Graded on spirit: PNG goes to tempfile() (app.R:33), HTML is written only to the downloadHandler's `file` (app.R:49), and all data is passed as explicit function arguments (tbl, p, value, group, source_name; app.R:99). App folder after download contains only app.R. No global variables used.

suggestions.assertion: The report is rendered from a template copied to tempdir() ...
suggestions.reason: Passes here only on spirit (no template, no params); the wording presumes rmarkdown/knitr templating and does not discriminate between runs.

eval_feedback.overall: All assertions pass. Weaknesses outside the assertions: a CSV with no numeric column gives a blank page (validate() at app.R:76 is inside an observer, so its message is never displayed; ready() fails silently), and n includes missing rows.
